verified.notes: Packed tarball 0.1.0 installed into an owned, disposable, non-Desktop web profile (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1). This release migrates the plugin to the v3 POC data model. The parser reads identity + gate0 + plan + progress[] + outcome; the four dimensions come from `outcome`; the progress stream is a new core view; the gap rule set grew from 8 to 12 (R1-R12); and the stat strip is now POC总数 / G0通过 / 进行中 / 金额合计. The v3 numbers were verified against the real ledger data first: 23 projects, 6050万 total, 1 G0 passed, 0 G0 complete, R1 on all 23, R2 on 7 — matching the update note's acceptance list exactly. dsh --profile <test> --dump-config composed the row; a bounded real startup served the Web app; the authenticated transport exercised the exact /api/skillre-work-dashboard/execute route (cold cache empty, manual refresh cloned the ledger, board computed v3 summaries and gaps, detail returned the progress stream, a second refresh used fetch + reset --hard, unknown project and unauthenticated request failed cleanly), and cleanup removed the owned profile with verified absence. The real DSH Web UI was then driven in headless Chromium: 43/43 assertions passed, including the seven-column v3 table, the amount column, the latest-progress column, the progress-stream section, four separate dimension cards, the twelve-rule pending list, and a new guard that no raw template placeholder reaches the DOM. Two real defects were caught during that verification and fixed: gap TITLES were rendered through t() instead of format() so parameterised titles leaked literal {amountWan}; and the detail identity line still carried the removed v1 {tier} key. The export form is deliberately hidden in this release: it still models v1 fields, and shipping it would hand colleagues YAML the v3 ledger cannot read. It is preserved at src/form.v1-deferred.ts for the P1 rewrite. The published 0.2.0 market entry was then verified end to end: the LIVE hosted index listed 工作看板 0.2.0, its own install spec (git+https://github.com/skillre/dsh-plugin-work-dashboard#42b7c9f2bf951cdd1715feda48b47bf81286bc0c) was installed into a fresh owned profile, --dump-config composed the row, a bounded startup served the app, and list/detail/risks/timeline all answered (detail correctly reported unknown-project on the cold cache). Cleanup removed the owned profile and verified it was gone.
verified.note: Packed tarball 0.5.0 installed into an owned, disposable, non-Desktop web profile (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1). This release ships the three POC skills inside the package and rewrites them for the v3 ledger. The skills previously lived in the user's skill directory and still described v1 (why_customer_test / result / timeline / gates.G0..G4 / success_criteria) and pointed at an external v1 Python generator, so a model reading them was told to use fields the ledger no longer has. They now live at skills/<name>/SKILL.md, ship in package.json#files, and are registered through DSH's optional `skills` service via ctx.inject (ctx.skills.register, source 'bundled'), with each disposer bound to the plugin's own Fiber so uninstalling removes them. `skills` is not a static inject: a profile without a skill registry still mounts the dashboard, and each skill registers inside its own try/catch so one bad file cannot take the others down. poc-ledger was rewritten for identity/gate0/plan/progress[]/outcome and the twelve gap rules (was eight), including the three caveats that keep the rules from over-firing. poc-export now runs a bundled scripts/export-form.mjs (a real v3 form with project-id-keyed autosave, live gap counting, focus preservation and JSON output) instead of the dead external poc_form.py. poc-submit now appends to progress[] with the next seq and preserves every untouched field instead of copying a v1 result block. Verification: npm run check passes (preview check, typecheck, 189 unit tests including 17 new skill tests that assert CONTENT — the ledger skill must not present removed v1 fields as schema and must list all twelve rules — lib-drift, pack check). The packed tarball was installed into a fresh owned profile and 31 isolated checks passed: the three skills are present in the installed package AND each one actually reached the skill catalog at boot (the registration line is emitted only when the service existed, the file parsed and the registry accepted the payload). The generated form was driven in a real browser. Cleanup removed the owned profile and its cache and verified the removal. Desktop Client (Electron) visual verification was not performed; see observations.

observations.desktopClientNote: The Web UI was verified directly. The Electron Desktop Client shares the same renderer but was not launched for this release; a Desktop-specific visual check remains outstanding.
observations.chartsWithoutDependency: Every figure is hand-built SVG or flex geometry because the client bundle may only externalise `react`. No charting dependency was added.
observations.displayContract: Adopted: locale meta.detail + one preview image per language + docs shipped in the package (evidence excluded).
observations.updateMechanism: npm registry install is the only channel that appears in the plugin manager Versions block; the market entry is Git-sourced and therefore uninstall-and-reinstall only.
observations.npmChannel: Blocked as of 2026-11-06: the npm auth token in ~/.npmrc returns HTTP 401 on /-/whoami, and the repository has no npm-publish environment or Trusted Publisher configured, so no version is on the registry and the official in-place update path is not yet reachable for users.
